verbose_level.description: Verbosity level (-v). Higher numbers provide more debugging output to stderr.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for every operation (-t).

max_host_connections.description: Maximum parallel connections to the same host (-M). 0 means unlimited.

stop_on_first_open.description: Stop probing other ports for an IP once an open proxy is found (-s).

print_closed.description: Write lines about definitely closed proxies to stdout (-n).

print_extended.description: Print extended proxy information like proxy-agent (-x).

host_list_file.description: File containing list of hosts to check (-i). Use '-' for stdin.

do_not_reset_defaults.description: Prepend new port specs instead of resetting the default list (-D).

dest_host.description: Destination host and port to establish a proxied connection to (-d).

check_method.description: Method to determine if a proxy is open (-c), e.g., chat::str:str or dsbl.

proto_port_specs.description: List of protocol:port specifications to probe (-p). Example: 'hc:3128,8080'. Items are flat strings.

hosts_to_check.description: List of hosts to check, specified on the command line. Items are flat strings.
